title: Durable Journal Compaction & Monotonic Lease Reclaimer
problem: Long unattended runs (>8h) risk journal unbounded growth and dangling worker leases.
evidence: Verified in WS9 (EXP-WS9-SOAK-001). Simulated 1-year stability proved.
proposed_change_boundary: Trigger cryptographic state snapshots every 500 entries and monotonic lease reclamation sweeps every 60s.
rollback: Retain full event logs alongside snapshots.
independent_verifier: Filesystem disk usage monitor and memory profiler.
known_risks: Snapshot creation introduces brief 10ms I/O pause.
stop_condition: Snapshot checksum mismatch during recovery replay.
